name: website_shop_cart
summary: Shopping carts, cart lines with price snapshots, addresses, and cart events
description: Cart lifecycle on top of the E-Commerce anchor: guest and registered carts with secure session tokens, line-level price snapshots, billing/shipping address snapshots, and cart lifecycle events for abandonment/recovery analytics. Amounts are treated as session snapshots; the backend remains the only trusted source of pricing.
author: Nexa
